text:
This looks like an arugula salad with a few golden raisins and maybe a light dressing, served on a square plate about 26 cm across. The greens cover a small portion of the plate, roughly a loose handful of about 40 g. Raisins and dressing add a little more, so I estimate about 50 g in total. Arugula has few calories, about 25 kcal per 100 g, so 40 g is roughly 10 kcal. A few raisins add about 15 kcal, and oil dressing adds about 40 kcal. That comes to roughly 65 kcal.
